real_machine_install.scope: Production SYNAPSE-5.70.1-Setup.exe installed silently on the build machine into the default application folder with a scratch preferences folder, verified by the bundled maintenance runtime, then uninstalled silently. Houdini 22.0.400 was closed. The machine develops SYNAPSE from its source tree, so its own registrations (a preferences package file and a user HOUDINI_PACKAGE_DIR) were parked for the duration and restored afterwards; neither was modified.
